adjudication.rationale: Verified in diff: Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed builds `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and calls `TopicEmbed.import(user, url, i.title, content)` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb). `TopicEmbed.import` creates the post via `PostCreator.new(... raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents), skip_validations: true, cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html])` (app/models/topic_embed.rb), and `Post#cook` returns `raw` when `cook_method` is `:raw_html`, explicitly skipping the rendering/sanitization pipeline (app/models/post.rb). The embed view renders `raw post.cooked` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb). Therefore any HTML in the feed item content (including `<script>` or event-handler attributes) can be published verbatim as post HTML, making this a real XSS/security defect introduced by this change.
